# ciphertrust_azure_vault_details (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve details of all Azure vaults available to a CipherTrust Manager Azure connection in a given subscription. Results are returned as a map keyed by vault name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve Azure Key Vault details for a subscription directly from Azure.
# Useful for discovering vaults before adding them to CipherTrust Manager.
# The result is a map keyed by vault name - pass an entry directly to the
# vault_details attribute of ciphertrust_azure_vault to skip the Azure lookup
# on creation.

resource "ciphertrust_azure_connection" "connection" {
  name          = "azure-connection"
  client_id     = "your-client-id"
  tenant_id     = "your-tenant-id"
  client_secret = "your-client-secret"
  products      = ["cckm"]
}

data "ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details" "subs" {
  connection_id = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
}

# List all Key Vaults in the subscription.
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_details" "vaults" {
  connection_id   = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
  subscription_id = data.ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details.subs.subscriptions[0].subscription_id
}

# List Managed HSM vaults in the same subscription.
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_details" "hsm_vaults" {
  connection_id   = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
  subscription_id = data.ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details.subs.subscriptions[0].subscription_id
  managed_hsms    = true
}

# Output the names of all discovered Key Vaults.
output "vault_names" {
  value = keys(data.ciphertrust_azure_vault_details.vaults.vaults)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) CipherTrust Manager Azure connection name or ID.
- `subscription_id` (String) Azure subscription ID to list vaults from.

### Optional

- `managed_hsms` (Boolean) When true, retrieves Azure Managed HSM vaults instead of standard Key Vaults.

### Read-Only

- `vaults` (Attributes Map) Map of vault name to vault details for all vaults in the subscription. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults))

<a id="nestedatt--vaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults`

Read-Only:

- `azure_vault_id` (String) Azure resource ID of the vault.
- `location` (String) Azure region where the vault is located.
- `name` (String) Vault name.
- `tags` (Map of String) Azure tags applied to the vault.
- `vault_properties` (Attributes) Azure vault properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults--vault_properties))
- `vault_type` (String) Azure resource type.

<a id="nestedatt--vaults--vault_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults.vault_properties`

Read-Only:

- `create_mode` (String) Vault create mode.
- `enable_purge_protection` (Boolean) Whether protection against purge is enabled.
- `enable_rbac_authorization` (Boolean) Whether RBAC is used for data action authorization.
- `enable_soft_delete` (Boolean) Whether soft delete is enabled for the vault.
- `enabled_for_deployment` (Boolean) Whether Azure Virtual Machines may retrieve certificates stored as secrets.
- `enabled_for_disk_encryption` (Boolean) Whether Azure Disk Encryption may retrieve secrets from the vault.
- `enabled_for_template_deployment` (Boolean) Whether Azure Resource Manager may retrieve secrets from the vault.
- `sku` (Attributes) SKU details for the vault. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults--vault_properties--sku))
- `soft_delete_retention_in_days` (Number) Soft delete data retention period in days.
- `tenant_id` (String) Azure Active Directory tenant ID for the vault.
- `vault_uri` (String) URI for performing operations on keys and secrets in this vault.

<a id="nestedatt--vaults--vault_properties--sku"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults.vault_properties.sku`

Read-Only:

- `family` (String) SKU family name.
- `name` (String) SKU name.
